mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to 12-month average over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing equity valuations to contract and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month averages over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%) with declining unemployment, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, causing a negative shift in equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp in 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The absolute level of monthly job additions (PAYEMS) serves as a real-time indicator of labor market strength; higher levels consistently correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month median over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month average and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average signals robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST > 12mo avg and GDPC1 > 4q avg over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0%) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve is perceived to be in a prolonged tightening cycle, causing equity valuations to contract and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high rates regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.
